XJwsSignature.name: x-jws-signature
XJwsSignature.description:
Detached JWS signature over the JSON notification payload. The JWS protected header contains the key ID (`kid`)
that identifies the Rabo Smart Pay signing key. Verify this signature before processing the event.

CardOnFile.description: The list of cards for the given shopper.

id.description: Uniquely identifies the card on file.

last4Digits.description: The last 4 digits of the card number. of 4 digits.

Currency.description: Currency, at this time only EUR is supported.

EnableCardOnFile.description: Enables storing card details for future use. Requires shopperRef and email address.

consumerMessage.description: An optional message that can be presented to the consumer. This field is deprecated.

FastCheckout.description:
Contains fields related to fast checkout flow. when this is defined, it activates the fast checkout flow.
When fast checkout is defined: 
 - paymentBrandForce must be specified and set to FORCE_ALWAYS.
 - specified paymentBrand must be set to 'IDEAL'

requiredCheckoutFields.description:
This field indicates the merchant's desire to receive checkout details of the shopper in
order status response. According to GDPR, the calling party must explicitly ask for the fields
that contain personal information. The requested data will be provided via GET /v2/orders/{orderId} endpoint.

Note: This field is needed only for the fast-checkout flow. At least one value must be defined.

durationInMillis.description: The duration of the access token in milliseconds.

token.description: The access token that authorizes the webshop to perform other API calls for a limited amount of time. After expiration a new access token must be retrieved.

validUntil.description: The timestamp indicating when the access token expires.

OrderAddress.description: This structure contains address details and is typically used in specifying billing and shipping details of an order.

city.description: The name of the city, will be truncated to 40 characters if longer.

firstName.description: The first name, will be truncated to 50 characters if longer.

houseNumber.description:
The house number, will be truncated to 100 characters if longer.
Note: In case of payment with Visa, Mastercard, Bancontact, V PAY and Maestro This field is truncated further to 10 characters.

houseNumberAddition.description: Any additions to the house number, will be truncated to 6 characters if longer.

lastName.description: The last name, will be truncated to 50 characters if longer.

middleName.description: The middle name, will be truncated to 20 characters if longer.

street.description:
The street name, will be truncated to 100 characters if longer.
Note: In case of payment with Visa, Mastercard, Bancontact, V PAY and Maestro this field is truncated further to 50 characters.

OrderAmount.description:
The total order amount in cents, including VAT. The amount must be equal to the sum over all order items of the piece price (including VAT) multiplied by the quantity.

Note: if the amount is not equal to the sum of the amounts of the order items then the order items from the order announcement are filtered.

OrderAnnouncementResponseV2.description: This structure describes the message that is returned in response to an order announcement.

omnikassaOrderId.description: The unique ID that Rabo Smart Pay assigned to this order. This ID can be later used to look up the order status that is communicated using the webhook notification mechanism or the order status endpoint.

redirectUrl.description: The URL to which the browser of the consumer must be redirected to. This URL points to the payment pages of Rabo Smart Pay.

OrderAnnouncementResponseV2.title: OrderAnnouncementResponse

OrderCustomerInformation.description: Customer details that are typically of interest for cards transactions.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the customer, formatted using  DD-MM-YYYY.

emailAddress.description: The e-mail address of the customer. If the email address contains more than 255 characters, the extra characters will be removed after the 255th character.

initials.description: The initials of the customer. If the initials contain more than 256 characters then the extra characters are removed after the 256th character.

telephoneNumber.description: The consumer's telephone number. If the phone number contains more than 31 characters, the extra characters are removed after the 31st character.

OrderDescription.description: Description of the order. If the description contains more than 35 characters then the extra characters are removed after the 35th character.

OrderId.description:
Unique order identifier, generated by Rabo Smart Pay when an order is 
announced.

OrderInitiatingParty.description: This field is used to track transactions initiated by a specific party. Only supply this field in consultation with the Rabobank.

OrderItem.description: This structure contains the details of a single order item of an order.

amount.description: The piece price of the order item, including VAT. This field can be negative to denote discounts.

description.description: A short description of the order item, truncated to 100 characters if longer.
description.example: These distinct, feminine frames balance a classic Jackie-O styling with a modern look.

id.description: An identifier for the order item, truncated to 25 characters if longer.

name.description: The name of the order item, truncated to 50 characters if longer.

tax.description: The VAT of the order item.

amount.description: The amount in cents. This field can be negative to denote discounts.

vatCategory.description:
The VAT category of the product. The values refer to the different rates used in the Netherlands.
1 = high (21%),
2 = low (9%),
3 = zero (0%),
4 = none (exempt from VAT)

OrderItems.description: An optional list of zero or more order items.

OrderLanguage.description: The language of the payment pages.

OrderMerchantOrderId.description:
Generated by the webshop. This field has two types of validations based on if the shopperBankstatementReference is supplied or not.
- if shopperBankstatementReference is supplied:
  It allows all ascii characters up to a length of 64 characters, if the ID contains more than 64 characters, the extra characters are removed after the 64th character.
- else:
  It should adhere to the pattern: '[A-Za-z0-9]{1,24}', if the ID contains more than 24 characters, the extra characters are removed after the 24th character.

OrderMerchantReturnUrl.description: The URL to which the consumer's browser will be redirected after the payment.

OrderPaymentBrand.description: This field is optional and is used to enforce a specific payment method with the consumer instead of the consumer selecting a payment method on the payment method selection page. The CARDS value ensures that the consumer can choose between payment methods: MASTERCARD, VISA, BANCONTACT, MAESTRO and V_PAY.

OrderPaymentBrandForce.description: This field should only be delivered if the paymentBrand field (see above) is also specified. In the case of FORCE_ONCE, the indicated paymentBrand is only enforced on the first attempt. If this fails, the consumer can still choose another payment method. When FORCE_ALWAYS is chosen, the consumer is not allowed choose another payment method.

OrderPaymentBrandMetaData.description: Additional metadata specific to the brand as set in the paymentBrand field.

issuerId.description: Use this field to immediately start an iDEAL transaction at a specific issuer. To do so set the paymentBrand field to 'IDEAL' and set this field to the BIC code of the iDEAL issuer. If this field is not included in the request then Rabo Smart Pay will first present a list of available issuers to the consumer before starting a transaction.

OrderResultsV2.description: This structure specifies the result of a single order.

errorCode.description: Future field, for now always empty.

merchantOrderId.description: Merchant order id, as provided during order announcement.

omnikassaOrderId.description: The unique ID that Rabo Smart Pay assigned to the order. This field matches the identically named field in the response of the order announcement.

orderStatus.description:
The status of the order:
* COMPLETED - Successful payment of the order.
* CANCELLED - The payment was cancelled.
* EXPIRED - The consumer has not paid within the stipulated period.

orderStatusDateTime.description: Timestamp of the moment that this status is reached.

paidAmount.description: When the order status is COMPLETED then this field contains the amount paid by the customer.

poiId.description: Unique identification of the webshop (point of interaction), as seen from Rabo Smart Pay.

totalAmount.description: This field contains the original order amount as supplied in the order announcement call.

transactions.description: A list of transactions with type AUTHORIZE and PAYMENT

items.description: A list of transactions with type AUTHORIZE and PAYMENT

confirmedAmount.description: The amount that was confirmed by the external payment processor. This field is only filled when the transaction status is SUCCESS or ACCEPTED.

OrderShopperBankstatementReferenceId.description: Generated by the webshop. If the ID contains more than 24 characters, the extra characters are removed after the 24th character.

OrderStatusResult.description: Order details, including the latest status.

merchantOrderId.description: Merchant order id, as provided during order announcement.

status.description:
The status of the order:
* COMPLETED - Successful payment of the order.
* CANCELLED - The payment was cancelled.
* EXPIRED - The consumer has not paid within the stipulated period.
* PARTIALLY_PAID - Payment of order is been partially done.
* IN_PROGRESS - Payment of order is yet to be finalized.

totalAmount.description: This field contains the original order amount as supplied in the order announcement call.

id.description:
Unique transaction identifier, generated by by Rabo Smart Pay when a
payment or refund transaction is started.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp of last transaction status update.

status.description:
Status of the transaction.
* SUCCESS - The transaction has succeeded.
* ACCEPTED - Indicates that the transaction has been successfully processed by the third party.
* CANCELLED - The transaction was canceled.
* EXPIRED - The transaction has expired.
* FAILURE - The transaction has failed.
* NEW - The transaction is created at Smart Pay, but the final status is not yet known.
* OPEN - The transaction is created at a third party, but the final status is not yet known.

OrderTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the order announcement. As a rule this is the current date and time.

firstName.description: The first name of the shopper

houseNumber.description: The house number of the address

lastName.description: The last name of the shopper

emailAddress.description: The e-mail address of the shopper

firstName.description: The first name of the shopper (can be different from the first name in the address)

lastName.description: The last name of the shopper (can be different from the first name in the address)

telephoneNumber.description: The phone number of the shopper

ShippingCost.description: The order shipping cost amount in cents. Only used for display purposes. Does not influence order total.

cardOnFileList.description: The list of cards for the given shopper.

ShopperRef.description:
This should be the parameter uniquely identifies the shopper within the merchant’s environment. 
When a card is stored, it is tied to the provided shopperRef. 
Stored cards can later be retrieved using the same shopperRef during subsequent payments.

SkipHppResultPage.description: This field is used by the Smart Pay API to determine whether the consumer should be redirected to the HPP result page or not. By default this field is set to false.

StatusResponseV2.description: This schema specifies the structure of the response when retrieving the events of recently processed orders.

moreOrderResultsAvailable.description: Indication if there are more order results available than in this message. In that case, a status pull call can be made (with the same notification token) to retrieve additional order results. This can be repeated until the value of this property is `false`.

signature.description: The hexadecimal representation of the cryptographic signature by applying HMAC-SHA512 on the fields above using the merchant signing key as secret key.

ConsumerContactDetails.description: Contact details of the consumer. Used for personalized communication and identification.

currency.description: 3 letter currency code as defined by ISO-4217

RefundReason.description: Indicates the business reason for the refund. Must be one of the supported refund reason categories. If not provided, the value defaults to 'OTHER'.

RefundVatCategory.description: The VAT category of the product. The values refer to the different rates used in the Netherlands.
